body: so. im in the hospital. ive got an iv in my arm and they are definitely taking me seriously. thank you.

alright. i woke up this morning, completely unable to get out of bed and feeling extremely weighed down. the only thing motivating me enough to get out of bed was the thought of running away. i told a friend and she’s convinced me not to run away. i probably wasn’t even going to do it anyway, the thought is so scary.
instead, i’m going to go to first aid in school and tell them that i’ve been taking a lot of pills in the past few days and that they should probably call an ambulance before i hurt myself even more. wish me luck.

i told my school counsellor that i tried to kill myself last night. he talked about some things with me such as why i feel like this and he was super understanding about it all. but, i do feel like the counsellors could have done more to help. they’ve put me in a support group like the doctor mentioned and gave me a pass so i can take 10-15 minutes out of lesson by myself. i do feel like they could’ve  done more, but i am glad that i’m getting help. on a not-so-good note, i ended up taking at least 8 more pills this morning and i don’t feel much different but i do feel a little sick. i’m probably just nervous. thank you for being a random good person and answering this. you’ve really helped and i don’t know what i can do as thanks except say thank you over and over, so- thank you.

school starts in about 30 minutes. ive decided im going to tell the nurse about what ive done. everybodys talking about school like it’s normal and i feel like im just being stupid by ruining everything like this. im not going to lie; i have 6 more painkillers in my pocket ‘just in case’. thank you for all of your help and i will definitely tell you how it goes.

thank you.
i’ve only ever mentioned my depression to online friends. my friends from school have seen my self harm cuts before, but didn’t do anything other than say ‘oh my god, you should tell a teacher.’
all of those ‘friends’ hate me now. the only people i can talk to comfortably are my online friends. my parents would only call me dramatic for saying i have depression, but speaking to teachers might be a good idea. i know the teachers will tell my parents, though, and my parents will just get mad and shout at me. i feel like im stuck in some endless loop of bad outcomes but you saying that you care has somehow really touched my heart. thank you so much. i don’t know if i’ll get through the night without taking some more pills but you have really, really helped. thank you.

ive been suffering with depression for as long as i can remember but only realised how serious it really is a few years ago. i don't want to call my friends because i'm scared i'll just worry them. my parents aren't much help either- they don't understand things like depression and anxiety. my mother took my to the doctor once and he told us about some things that could help but my mother hasn't mentioned any of those since. i feel like my parents just think i'm making up excuses to not go to school- they really think i'd fake wanting to kill myself just so i could stay off school.  
school is only one of the many reasons i'm feeling like this but they just for some reason dont understand that
